svg.title: A year of commits as a Sharingan: 2662 commits on 120 days
svg.desc: Each of the 371 points is one day of the last year, arranged as 53 weekly spokes and 7 daily rings around Sasuke’s turning Mangekyō Sharingan. Brighter points mean more commits. Longest streak 13 days, busiest day 112 commits.
